evals.prompt: Write a PR body for my branch that switches the image upload from a single request to chunked uploads.
evals.expected_output: Summary with one small visual (call tree or diff sketch), Evidence before/after, Merge Danger with door and blast radius; no invented evidence.
expectations: Reads the log and diff against the base branch
Uses the Summary / Evidence / Merge Danger structure
Summary includes one small visual such as a call tree or diff sketch
Evidence shows before and after, or says what evidence is missing instead of inventing it
Merge Danger names one-way or two-way door and a blast radius

evals.prompt: Write the PR description for 'Message delivery 02 — late delivery report corrects a sweep failure'. It came from our vflow ticket and check already passed.
evals.expected_output: Standard template plus the optional Verification section: ticket and spec links, level, checked SHA, INV-n coverage table, closing keyword.
expectations: Uses the Summary / Evidence / Merge Danger structure
Adds a Verification section linking the ticket and spec with level and checked SHA
Lists the INV-n covered with the test or model invariant
Puts the tracker's closing keyword for the ticket on its own line

evals.prompt: Open a PR for this README typo fix. The repo has a .github/pull_request_template.md.
evals.expected_output: Fills the repo's template with a short summary, light evidence, two-way door; opens the PR with the forge CLI from the branch; does not merge.
expectations: Reads and fills the repo's PR template headings
Keeps the body short; no unnecessary visuals
Opens the PR from the current branch with a body file
Does not merge or push to main
